chapters.title: Chapter 1: Key Lento and the swamps

items.name: Get Shirley's Rum
items.d: A small job for Shirley, Jason's neighbour in Key Lento.

items.name: Steal the Scooter
items.d: Shirley's second job.

items.name: The errands before Coming Home
items.d: Pick up Groceries, Buy Flowers, Buy Lucia a Necklace, Get The Chop and Get Lucia's Clothes, all before you collect Lucia.

items.name: Find the Lost Drugs
items.d: Search four zones of the swamp for packages that beep.

items.name: Clock Out
items.d: Pick Lucia up from work before 4 PM.

items.name: Donnie's Lost Drugs
items.d: Dive to Donnie's sunken boat off Corsair Key.

items.name: Pick Up A Gun
items.d: A quick stop at the gun store in Port Gellhorn.

items.name: Check Out McKittrick Farm
items.when: From Kyle's flyer at the motel
items.d: Kyle's first job, the start of a Strangers & Freaks strand.

items.name: Collect Chemicals for Kyle
items.when: About a day after his first job
items.d: Kyle's second job.

items.name: Thrillbillies
items.d: Billy's dirt-bike race at the Mud Club.

items.name: Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab
items.d: Billy's second job.

items.name: Hit Avery Pawn
items.d: Rob the pawn shop in Port Gellhorn.

items.name: Hit Kingpin Bowling
items.d: Rob the bowling alley the Kolts took over. A trophy depends on it.

items.name: Impounded Vehicle
items.d: Take Lucia's car back from the police lot.

items.name: Veteran Hunted
items.d: Bret's first hunt, which opens his Target Decks.

items.name: Get Your Wheels
items.d: Get a car of your own in Vice City.

items.name: Join a Street Race
items.d: Yago's first race in Salton.

items.name: Buddy?
items.d: Kyle's last job. Finishing it counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

items.name: Bumper to Bumper
items.d: Yago's second job, at his shop in Little Cuba.

items.name: Race Against Yago
items.when: Later in the chapter · limited time
items.d: Take it the moment it shows up.

items.name: Mall Rats
items.d: Billy's third job, a jewelry store in a mall.

items.name: Brother to Brother
items.d: Yago's last job. Finishing it counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

items.name: It's A Date!
items.d: A drink with your partner at the Courtyard Bar.

items.name: Bad Driver!
items.d: Track down Felipe at a bar in Millport. Gone once Power Play starts.

items.name: Attend Eddie Acosta's Party
items.when: A few days after you meet him · alone
items.d: A rooftop party in Vice City.

items.name: Dre'Quan's Gift
items.d: Pick up a race bike behind the Pay 'n' Spray in La Perle.

items.name: This Is a Free Call From…
items.when: After Child's Play · Lucia · limited time
items.d: Shayna's one-off call. Take it straight away.

items.name: That's Where The Money Is…
items.d: Opens the eight large bank vaults.

sources.label: PowerPyx: GTA 6 Full Walkthrough - All Missions

Every Optional entry and its place in each chapter's order; hourglass icon for time-sensitive jobs; black icon with pink text = optional; completed optional missions aren't listed anywhere in the game; order can vary, a job may need other missions or a sleep first.
